newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Bank rises after names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank rises after names new CEO.

text.p: Shares in Germany's largest commercial bank, Deutsche Bank, climbed on Wednesday after it said management board member Rolf Breuer would suceed Hilmar Kopper as chief executive.
Deutsche Bank added 74 pfennigs, or over one percent, to trade at 71.10 marks and was stronger than the rest of the DAX index of 30 leading shares, which was up 0.61 percent at 2,689.90 points.

"The naming of Rolf Breuer as sucessor to Hilmar Koppper is a bit of a surprise," said Dieter Hein, banking analyst at BHF-Bank, "But the decision is logical, because Deutsche Bank wants to become an investment bank with global operations."
